title: feat(pm): one mailbox per seat, not per account — the opener, the roster and the doorbell reader key it by seat
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2cPZcSqcFUZKTUoTXR4rBS)_

Fixes #27637

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:信箱从「每账号一个」改为「每席一个」。开信箱必须带 `--seat`,分支、正文首行、消息首行都按席位写;总表按席位行显示信箱,按账号开的旧信箱单列标出,不再挂到该账号的各个席位上。
- 为什么改:一个账号常坐好几个席位,而一个 PR 的事件同一时间只送到一个订阅会话。按账号开的信箱只能叫醒其中一席,其余席位收不到信,发信方和收信方都不知道。
- 风险与回滚:只动 PM 工具脚本和两份规则文本,不碰产品包、不发版。合并后,没有 `To:` 行的旧格式信箱评论会被读成半态,所以三个旧信箱(#27523、#27357、#27309)要由后续卡线程关掉并按席重开。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 头注里「The key is the seat, never the login」一节和步骤 ①;`project-forms.md`〈信箱 PR〉的前四行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`、`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`、`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` 三个都应通过;`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --seat domain:ui#4 --login os-bill --dry-run` 应打印分支 `mailbox/os-bill/ui-4`。
- 需要你做的:欠契约复审;Tier H,维护者批准。

## What changes

The mailbox PR is keyed by the **seat**, not the account. The shape is the one the card rules: the branch is `mailbox/LOGIN/SLUG` (e.g. `mailbox/os-bill/ui-4` for the seat `domain:ui#4`), the body opens `Mailbox-of: SEAT · LOGIN`, and a message opens `To: SEAT` with the doorbell key on the next line.

- **`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`**
  - `--seat LANE#N` is required to open. A seat's lane is one of the four a seat post names (`domain:X`, `repo:X`, `triage`, `director`), so a login is never read as a seat. An absent number reads as seat 1. The key is canonical and lower-cased (`triage` becomes `triage#1`). The slug drops the default `domain:` kind and turns `:` and `#` into `-`.
  - Step ① refuses a second open mailbox for the same **seat**, whichever login holds it. A second seat under the same login opens freely.
  - A legacy per-login mailbox (head `mailbox/LOGIN`, or a body opening `To: LOGIN`) names no seat. It blocks nothing, and the open prints it so the account closes it.
  - `mailboxOwner(pr)` is now the one reading of whose mailbox a pull is. `fleet-roster.mjs` and the self-test use it.
  - The header's argument that "a login holds one seat at a time, so a per-login refusal is a per-seat one" is rewritten, not patched.
  - Unchanged: `--close`, the `pm:mailbox` / `pinned` / `skip-changeset` labels, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION`, "never merged, never readied, owes no CI", and the `--head` cloud path.
- **`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`**
  - `mailboxLogin` is replaced by the opener's `mailboxOwner`. Its two callers (`buildRows`, `readLive`) were measured, and nothing outside this file imported it.
  - The mailbox column is now read per seat row.
  - A legacy per-login mailbox, or a per-seat one whose seat has no seat post, is listed under the table as assigned to no seat. It is never attributed to the login's rows. It is also in `--json` as `unassignedMailboxes`.
  - The fixture gains the per-seat, two-seats-under-one-login, head-only, legacy and no-seat-post shapes.
- **`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`**
  - `readMailboxLine` reads a `To: SEAT` line after the optional signature and before the key, and returns it as `to`. The seat is read with the opener's `seatKey`, imported rather than spelled a second time.
  - It refuses a message with no `To:` line, a `To:` naming a login, and a `To:` with no key under it.
  - The 200-byte cap still counts the key line only.
  - Every key refusal in the doorbell battery is now asked under a `To:` line, so none can pass just because the envelope is missing.
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md`** 〈信箱 PR〉: the text and the PR body template now say the same thing. One mailbox per seat, keyed by seat, opened at seating and subscribed by the seated session, closed at hand-over or account switch, and messages that open `To: SEAT`. The line count is unchanged at 54, and the ceiling is 54.
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md`** 〈交接收尾清单〉: step 9 now names the close and the successor's reopen, folded into the existing line. The line count is unchanged at 88, and the ceiling is 88.

## Why

One account routinely holds several seats. A PR's activity reaches one subscribed session at a time, so a mailbox keyed by login wakes one of that account's seats and the others never hear. Nothing tells the sender or the recipient. The card's board reading on 2026-10-29: one login held two `domain:server` seats and `domain:ui#1` behind one mailbox, and another held three `domain:ui` seats and had none.

Measured on `origin/main` `ddab8b99`, the writer and the reader also disagreed. The opener wrote `To: LOGIN` as the body's first line, while the roster read `Mailbox-of:`. So every mailbox opened on a `--head` branch was invisible to the roster's mailbox column. Two of the three live mailboxes are on that path (#27523, #27357). This diff gives both sides one spelling, and a self-test case feeds the opener's own body to the reader.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on head `c2792c09` derives 38 families, and all 38 ran and exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 because its prerequisite, the `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` dist, was missing. After `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` it exited 0, and the record carries that rerun.
- These were also run, and each exited 0:
  - `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`: 67 cases in 10 batteries.
  - `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: 82 cases.
  - `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`: 326 cases.
  - `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.
  - `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` and `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`. These are the two that the new `record-recognisers` → `mailbox-open` import could have deadlocked through a top-level-await cycle. Neither did.
  - `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`.
  - `pnpm lint`.
- `origin/main` moved 7 commits past the base, to `c91a004f`. None of them touches a path in this diff.

Mutation probes. Each change was reverted in a scratch copy of the file, the self-test was run, and the copy was deleted:

- `openMailboxesOf` matching by login turns `mailbox-open --self-test` red: "two seats under ONE login both open".
- The roster's mailbox column attributed by account turns `fleet-roster --self-test` red, with 3 cases.
- A `To:` line that accepts any value turns `record-recognisers --self-test` red, with 4 cases.

In-flight intersection, re-run before the first edit: of the 17 open PRs on objectstack at about 01:55Z, 13 are not mailboxes or the Version Packages PR. All 13 heads were fetched and diffed against their merge base, and 0 touch any path in this diff.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Migration (card-thread follow-up after landing, not this diff)

- Each of #27523, #27357 and #27309 is closed by its account (`mailbox-open.mjs --close N`) and reopened once per seat (`--seat LANE#N`).
- ⚠️ `refs/heads/mailbox/os-justin` (#27309's head) must be **deleted after #27309 closes** and before that account's first per-seat open on the default path. Git refuses a ref nested under an existing ref. This was measured on 2026-10-30 on a local bare repository, where pushing `mailbox/os-justin/server-3` beside `mailbox/os-justin` was rejected with `failed to update ref`. The opener's header and its push-failure message say so.
- Until then, a patrol reading the legacy mailboxes sees their old key-first comments as half-states (no `To:` line). That is report-only.

## Deviations

- **Tier.** The register (`GOVERNED_SURFACES`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) rows `.claude/**` on objectstack as **Tier S**, and the only governed paths here are `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/*`. Triage (comment 6501344388) writes **Tier H**. The seat takes the stricter one, **Tier H**, and the maintainer approves.
- **File surface.** The claim's surface was amended before push to add `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (a `To: SEAT` line broke its reader, measured: refused above the key, unreadable below it), `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json` (the roster self-test's snapshot), and `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈交接收尾清单〉 (the hand-over steps live there, not in `project-forms.md`).
- The `mailbox-open` and `fleet-roster` self-tests are not wired into any CI job or `package.json` script on `main`. They were run by hand here, and wiring them is out of scope.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (Except the Chinese 维护者速读 channel.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
